fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Tracked mechanized platoons sacrifice road speed for all-terrain capability, carrying their infantry across ground that would halt wheeled vehicles. The FWLM assigns these formations to worlds where rough terrain or poor infrastructure demands mobility that wheels cannot provide. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire at close range, these platoons trade precision for volume, putting enough rounds downrange to suppress enemy positions and deny open ground to advancing troops.
